Create one wide 16:9 landscape image, with no border or typography. Frame her from the waist up in a medium close-up, slightly left of center: her head, torso, and map should fill most of the left half of the image. A long white commuter train with a muted teal stripe remains clearly visible across the right half of the background. If a person appears, give them simplified expressive drawn features. Balance muted warm and cool color masses derived from the supplied local hues, preserving the color identities of hair, clothing, and objects without requiring a red accent; let soft light consistent with the supplied scene and time of day separate foreground and distance. Preserve enough surface texture to feel painted on paper. Avoid transparent watercolor blooms, glossy acrylic shine, photorealistic skin, and perfectly smooth vector fills.
images.scenePrompt: Create one wide 16:9 landscape image, with no border or typography. A young adult East Asian woman with shoulder-length dark brown hair blowing gently to the left and expressive brown eyes wears a rust-red hooded coat and a black backpack. She holds an unfolded paper map in both hands at chest level, with the entire map visible near the lower edge. Frame her from the waist up in a medium close-up, slightly left of center: her head, torso, and map should fill most of the left half of the image. Her body is turned three-quarters to the right, and she looks up toward the right with a curious, slightly uncertain expression. She stands on a sunlit outdoor commuter-train platform. A long white commuter train with a muted teal stripe remains clearly visible across the right half of the background. The platform canopy and columns recede diagonally from the upper left; a few indistinct commuters stand far behind her. Keep the woman, map, platform, and train all clearly visible.

qualityNotes.en: Matte opaque brush marks and warm/cool color planes are visible, with brown hair, a rust-red coat and a teal train stripe. Brushwork and map detail remain dense.
qualityNotes.ja: マットな不透明の筆跡、暖冷色の面、茶髪・赤茶コート・青緑の列車帯が見えます。筆跡は背景全体に細かく、地図も描き込まれています。
